headword: {月極駐車場|つきぎめちゅうしゃじょう}
reading: つきぎめちゅうしゃじょう
gloss: monthly parking lot; monthly rental parking space

definitions.gloss: monthly rental parking space; reserved monthly parking lot
definitions.explanation: A parking space or lot rented on a monthly basis with a fixed fee, as opposed to coin-operated or hourly parking. Extremely common in Japanese cities.

examples.japanese: {月極駐車場|つきぎめちゅうしゃじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{借|か}りている→借りる：00532_kariru⟧。
examples.english: I rent a monthly parking space.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{辺|あた}り→辺り：01770_atari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{月極駐車場|つきぎめちゅうしゃじょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧{二万円|にまんえん}くらいだ。
examples.english: Monthly parking lots around here cost about 20,000 yen per month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}した→引っ越す：01171_hikkosu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{近|ちか}く⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{月極駐車場|つきぎめちゅうしゃじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}さ→探す：00493_sagasu⟧⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。

notes: Compound of ⟦{月極|つきぎめ}→月極：13000_tsukigime⟧ (monthly basis/fixed monthly) + ⟦{駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう}→駐車場：01667_chuushajou⟧ (parking lot). The word ⟦{月極|つきぎめ}→月極：13000_tsukigime⟧ is a common sight on signs throughout Japan but is often misread as 'げっきょく' by learners; the correct reading is つきぎめ. Contrasts with ⟦コインパーキング→コインパーキング：24421_koinpaakingu⟧ (coin-operated parking) and {時間貸|じかんが}し⟦{駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう}→駐車場：01667_chuushajou⟧ (hourly parking). Monthly parking is essential in Japanese cities where most apartments do not include parking.
